title: It's Like This Every Day for Her

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin's days don't end with training sessions. She also works a variety of part-time jobs to earn the money to fund her sisters' dance classes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Training, classes, and part-time work—she gives each of them her all. Ines Fujin spares no effort as she prepares for her debut race, the first step toward her dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin's coworkers, inspired by her incredible work ethic, lend their encouragement. She's charming people left, right, and center—myself included.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If we have less time to train, then I'll just have to make it up with pure support! As her trainer, I'll do whatever I can!
